NDT software in Regina: one system for a mixed southern Saskatchewan workload

An NDT company in Regina rarely lives off a single industry. On the north side of the city, the Co-op Refinery Complex runs turnarounds that pull in inspection crews from across the Prairies. Regina is also home to a large steel pipe mill, and the Enbridge mainline corridor passes through the region. Within a couple of hours' drive are potash mines such as K+S Bethune and Mosaic's Belle Plaine operation, and further southeast the Estevan and Weyburn oilfields and SaskPower's coal-fired stations at Estevan. A Regina inspection contractor can be doing refinery exchanger tubes one week and weld inspection on a mine plant expansion the next.

That mix makes admin harder than the inspection itself. Every client has its own report format, its own vendor paperwork and its own idea of what an invoice should show. The Atlantis ERP solution gives a Regina NDT company one system configured for NDT and inspection work: technician certifications, procedures, instruments and calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quoting and invoicing. It is affordable, accessible and fully customized. Demo and quote on request.

ERP for NDT companies in Regina: the apps behind the work

An ERP for NDT companies in Regina should let a small office support several very different client types without keeping a separate spreadsheet for each. The Atlantis ERP organises the work into NDT-specific apps on one database.

  • NDT Reports with per-client versioned templates and 17 report types.
  • Certificates for technician certifications, vision tests and company accreditations.
  • Procedures for a controlled register ready for client and regulator audits.
  • Asset Management for instruments, calibration and consumables.
  • Team Assignments for dispatch across the refinery, the mines and the southeast oilfield.
  • Quotations and Invoicing with NDT-specific lines.

CRM, Project, Timesheets, Fleet, Purchase and Dashboards fill in the rest. Below, each is applied to real Regina-area work.

NDT reporting software for refinery, pipe mill and mine clients

NDT reporting software for Regina has to produce very different outputs for different clients without a technician rebuilding a template every time. The Atlantis ERP stores versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF and HTML with your logo, header and footer, and Excel templates are filled automatically by mapping fields to cells. A refinery's exchanger inspection sheet, a mine's weld inspection form and your own standard report can all be produced from the same data.

The 17 report types cover what a Regina contractor meets: IRIS and ECT for heat exchanger and condenser tubes during refinery turnarounds; UT, PAUT and TOFD for welds; RT with source, technique, IQI type and placement; MT and PT for structural and pressure welds at mine plants; UT thickness readings by direction; PMI, hardness, ferrite and PWHT for alloy and repair work; holiday/coating for lined vessels and pipe; MFL with scan mode for tank floors. Weld and job lines record defect type and orientation, and every report closes with acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

The workflow runs draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party or authorized inspector field. Work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard references are captured on the report. The offline field app handles sites without signal, from mine surface plants to lease sites around Weyburn. See Digital Twin Reporting Software for more.

Technician certification tracking software for Saskatchewan crews

Technician certification tracking software keeps a Regina contractor on each client's approved list. Refinery and mine contractor coordinators want certificates before site access, and a lapsed certificate can stop a crew at the gate. In the Atlantis ERP each record holds scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT and training hours, exam result and attachments, and the status is computed as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked.

Saskatchewan technicians generally hold ISO 9712 certificates through the Canadian national program administered by the Canadian General Standards Board (formerly NRCan). Crews working on US-owned assets may also hold SNT-TC-1A employer certifications; CP-189, PCN and CSWIP are recorded too. The employee NDT profile adds highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry.

Vision tests are tracked with near vision (Jaeger J1/J2), far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner and clinic. The ERP creates warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires, sends configurable email alerts, and warns on timesheets when a technician without a valid certificate logs hours. Certificate templates per scheme hold validity months and minimum OJT and training hours, which helps when tracking a trainee's progress toward Level II. Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based training via eLearning; ISO 9712 and other schemes are recorded, not taught.

Procedures and TSASK-era documentation

In Saskatchewan, boilers and pressure vessels fall under the Technical Safety Authority of Saskatchewan (TSASK), while oil and gas facilities and pipelines are regulated by the provincial Ministry of Energy and Resources. Clients working under those regimes expect their NDT subcontractors to work to approved, controlled procedures and to show which revision was used. The Atlantis ERP does not interpret code or regulatory requirements, but it keeps your procedure register clean and auditable.

The Procedures app records document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and body text or an uploaded file. Procedures go through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected and archived states and named, dated preparers, reviewers and approvers. Approved revisions are locked, and each revision keeps a snapshot. Pending approvals trigger email notifications and reminders.

For a new technique or a client-specific variant, an AI-assisted first draft gives the Level III a starting point, and a built-in template is used as a fallback. The Level III still reviews and approves before anything is published. NCR and CAPA workflows can be configured during implementation, and company certifications such as ISO 9001 carry their own alert days.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software across southern Saskatchewan

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Regina has to handle long drives and short notice: a call-out to a potash mill, a refinery turnaround that needs extra hands, a pipeline repair in the southeast. In Team Assignments each job moves through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates.

The technician availability calendar holds assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable entries, and overlaps are blocked. Equipment serial numbers cannot be double-booked, and the dispatcher is warned if an assigned instrument is out of calibration. Technician status, current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date show in calendar, kanban and list views, which helps a small Regina office see at a glance whether it can take on a turnaround without letting down a regular mine client.

Winter matters here: a planned trip to Estevan or Esterhazy can move by a day when highways close. Because assignments hold mobilisation dates and the calendar blocks conflicts, rescheduling one job shows immediately what else it affects. Fleet records vehicle purpose, whether the vehicle can carry radioactive sources, the transport licence number and expiry, and vehicle assignment to project and driver with dates and mileage, which keeps radiography trucks and their paperwork together.

Calibration management software for a shared instrument pool

A Regina contractor usually runs a modest instrument pool shared across every client, so one late calibration can affect several jobs. Calibration management software needs to show that risk early. The Atlantis ERP tracks each instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number with type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status, and records calibration frequency and status.

Calibration records include provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result and next due date. The certificate register stores the lab accreditation number and PDF with valid, expiring and expired status and sends expiry alerts. Reservations prevent clashes, issue and return requires supervisor and manager approval, and condition is recorded both ways.

The maintenance log covers preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement. Consumables such as couplant, penetrant, developer, MT particles and PPE have reorder levels and a low-stock flag with a movement ledger. In Purchase, calibration labs, OEMs and dealers are vendor types with accreditation number and expiry, and order lines link to the equipment serial being serviced. Rental rates can be recorded for instruments you rent out or rent in during busy periods.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Regina contractors

NDT quoting and invoicing software needs to handle both a refinery's formal purchase order process and a mine's smaller call-out work. Quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded quotation PDF. Clients can accept and sign online, and the quote converts to a sales order.

Timesheets capture inspection, travel, standby and setup time with method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag and rate multiplier, and approval before billing. Long drives from Regina to site are a real cost and should be billed where the contract allows; the timesheet is where that is recorded. Expenses capture per diems, hotels and field purchases to re-bill.

Invoices carry the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables and lines showing cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. GST and Saskatchewan PST treatment is configured during implementation. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses across twelve months, which shows which client type is actually profitable.

Inspection management software in Regina: dashboards, CRM and integrations

Inspection management software gives the owner of a Regina company the view a bigger firm gets from a full admin team. Dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue, alongside financial KPIs.

CRM records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, with an NDT lead score from 0 to 100. Drip email sequences by service line keep in touch with mine maintenance planners and fabricators between jobs, and business card scanning turns a card into a lead. The open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation, so invoices can flow to your accounting package or client work order numbers can flow in.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Regina: implementation

An affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Regina should fit a lean team. Atlantis NDT configures and supports the system, and pricing is quote on request.

  1. Client mapping. List your client types and the report, quote and invoice format each expects.
  2. Record import. Certificates, vision tests, instruments, calibration history, vehicles and procedures.
  3. Template build. Client-specific report and invoice templates, including mapped Excel formats.
  4. Tax and billing setup. GST, PST, rate types and cost centres configured.
  5. Field rollout. Offline app on crew devices, tested on a live job.

Founder Anoop Rayavarapu is an ASNT NDT Level III. Book a Regina NDT ERP demo.

Best NDT software for small NDT companies in Regina

Many Regina NDT companies are small, owner-run firms. The best NDT software for them removes after-hours admin: reports finished on site, certificates that flag themselves, invoices built from approved timesheets. A common starting set is NDT Reports, Certificates, Asset Management, Timesheets and Invoicing, with Procedures and Team Assignments added later. Get a quote for a small Regina NDT company or ask about your client report templates.

Frequently asked questions

Is there NDT software in Regina that handles refinery and mine report formats?

Yes. The Atlantis ERP stores versioned templates per format and fills Excel templates automatically, so one set of inspection data can produce each client's required report.

Does the ERP cover IRIS and eddy current reports for exchangers?

Yes. IRIS and ECT are among the 17 report types, with the same review, approval and signature workflow as other methods.

Can it help with TSASK or client audits?

It keeps a controlled procedure register with locked approved revisions, certificate records and calibration records ready to show. It does not interpret regulatory requirements.

Can the ERP handle GST and PST on invoices?

Taxes are configured per country and province during implementation.

Do you offer NDT training in Saskatchewan?

Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based training online through eLearning. ISO 9712 certificates are recorded in the ERP but not trained.

How is the Atlantis ERP priced?

Quote on request, based on the apps, templates and integrations you need.
